title: Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End to Officially Return With New Spinoff Amid Hiatus
content: Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End has unfortunately been on an indefinite hiatus for the past year with no signs of coming back anytime soon , but the series will be kicking off an official new spinoff series in the meantime.
author: ComicBook

title: Duel Masters Pure PLAY'S Manga Ends on November 30
content: Shogakukan 's Weekly CoroCoro Comic platform will publish the final chapter of the Duel Masters Pure PLAY'S manga, based on the Duel Masters PLAY'S smartphone game, on November 30. The manga launched on Weekly CoroCoro Comic on September 14. Reki Yayoi is drawing the manga.
author: ANN

title: Netflix Locks Down Release Date for Major 2027 Exclusive – Watch New Trailer
content: Netflix has acquired the exclusive streaming rights to one of the most enigmatic power fantasies and love stories, beginning in January 2027. The giant streaming platform has gained significant access to the anime world over the past few years, bringing many popular anime to its platform.
author: ComicBook

title: Disney Villains Anime Releases New Season 2 Trailer Ahead of Disney+ Debut – Watch Now
content: Disney’s classic roster of villains have been taking over the anime world in a wild new kind of way, and now fans have gotten a much better look at its Season 2 return with the first full trailer helping to show it all off.
author: ComicBook

title: Twisted-Wonderland: Episode of Savanaclaw Anime's New Video Unveils Ending Song
content: Disney+ Japan started streaming the "payoff promotional video" for Disney Twisted-Wonderland The Animation: Episode of Savanaclaw , the second season for the Disney Twisted-Wonderland The Animation series , on Tuesday.
author: ANN

title: Witch on the Holy Night Anime Film's Sequel Confrmed
content: The staff for the Witch on the Holy Night ( Mahōtsukai no Yoru ) anime film confirmed on Tuesday that it will receive a sequel. The staff also announced that the film has sold 301,630 tickets for 516,132,800 yen (about US$3.24 million) over its first four days.
author: ANN

title: All You Need Is Kill, Kaguya!, Grotesqqque, More Anime Confirmed Eligible for Oscars
content: The Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences announced the films eligible for consideration for the 99th Annual Academy Awards in the Animated Feature, International Feature, and Documentary Feature categories on Monday.
author: ANN

title: 'Mahoutsukai no Yoru' Sequel Anime Announced
content: The official X (formerly Twitter) account for the anime movie adaptation of Type-Moon 's Mahoutsukai no Yoru ( Witch on the Holy Night ) visual novel announced on Tuesday that a sequel anime is in production.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Getbackers Voice Comic Staff Apologizes for Generative AI Use in PR Video
content: The official X (formerly Twitter ) account for the voice comic of Yūya Aoki and Rando Ayamine 's Getbackers manga apologized to fans for the use of generative AI in a promotional video last week, and the resulting misunderstanding, confusion, and worry among fans.
author: ANN
